content_blocks.markdown:
**Arguments**
```json
{
  "function": "() => {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const text = document.body.innerText;
      // Find where B07HDVVZ1B or 608-N-L-210 appears
      const hasAsin = text.includes('B07HDVVZ1B');
      const hasSku = text.includes('608-N-L-210');
      
      let snippet = '';
      if (hasAsin || hasSku) {
        const idx = text.indexOf(hasAsin ? 'B07HDVVZ1B' : '608-N-L-210');
        snippet = text.slice(Math.max(0, idx - 200), idx + 800);
      } else {
        snippet = text.slice(1000, 2000);
      }
      
      resolve({
        hasAsin,
        hasSku,
        snippet
      });
    }, 2000);
  });
}",
  "pageId": 1,
  "waitForStableDom": false
}
```
